channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: Prime Intellect launches Prime Inference: serverless and reserved GPU serving for open models, tuned for 100 tok/s agents
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Prime Intellect launched Prime Inference: serverless endpoints and reserved capacity for frontier open models on its own NVIDIA Blackwell fleet, tuned for agentic workloads at 100 tokens per second per user.

item.title: Give your AI agent eyes on the whole internet: hands-on with Agent Reach, the 89K-star toolkit
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Agent Reach (89K+ stars, MIT) gives any coding agent read-and-search access to X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and more — one CLI, zero API fees. Install it, run agent-reach doctor, and put the social internet behind a single command.

item.title: Springer retracts a peer-reviewed AI review over undeclared generative AI — the citations gave it away
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Discover Artificial Intelligence, a Springer Nature journal, has retracted a 2024 review on AI in communication research after concluding it was written with undeclared generative AI. The giveaway was the references: contextually wrong citations, the classic fingerprint of machine-generated scholarship.

item.title: Free Gemini = Flash-Lite only: Google moves Flash and Pro behind paywalls on October 9
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Google's updated support docs say free-tier users lose the Flash and Pro models on October 9 and keep only Flash-Lite. AI Plus loses Pro too; paid Pro and Ultra tiers gain Deep Think.

item.title: Make your coding agent talk like a caveman: a hands-on guide to cutting its token bill
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: caveman (109K stars, Apache-2.0) teaches your coding agent to talk like a caveman: a one-command skill trims its output, a local proxy shrinks what it reads before every call — measured at -33.2% input tokens, red rows and all. The hands-on setup.

item.title: Kolibri has landed: Aleph Alpha drops a 78B open-weight German/English model — Apache 2.0, trained in the EU
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Aleph Alpha released Kolibri on October 3: a 78B-parameter mixture-of-experts model for German and English, open-weight under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face, trained from scratch in Germany and Finland.

item.title: Stop your coding agent trusting stale docs: a hands-on guide to seiso
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: seiso (MIT, ~170 stars) is a Markdown convention and linter built for docs written by AI and read by humans and agents. Install it, declare each document's kind, hook it into Claude Code — and make stale docs fail loudly.

item.title: FieldAI lands $700M at a $10B valuation: the mapless robot-brain startup 5x'd in a year
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Business Insider reports the Irvine robot-software startup closed a $700M Series C at a $10B valuation — five times its 2025 mark — on mapless navigation that already earns $135M across 30+ customers.

item.title: Read arXiv papers like a well-typeset book: a hands-on guide to EasyRead
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: EasyRead (MIT, 600+ stars) re-typesets any PDF into a bilingual book on your own machine — formulas and tables intact, AI answers in the margin, and a CLI your coding agents can drive. The hands-on setup.

item.title: GitHub Copilot retires four AI models — Opus 4.7, Kimi K2.7 Code, and two older Gemini Flashes are gone; six more go October 19
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: GitHub deprecated four Copilot models on October 2 — Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Kimi K2.7 Code, and Claude Opus 4.7 — with six more retiring October 19. If you pinned a model name in your workflow, today is your day to move it.

item.title: Broadcom lines up $60B in debt to bankroll AI chips for Anthropic — the vendor is borrowing to lend
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Bloomberg reports banks have begun gathering $60 billion in debt — a $42 billion senior-secured tranche plus an $18 billion junior tranche led by Blackstone — so Broadcom can finance AI chips and infrastructure for Anthropic and other companies.

item.title: Tesla delivered 486,532 vehicles in Q3 — beating the street by 24,600, while energy storage fell short
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Tesla reported 486,532 vehicle deliveries for Q3 2026, beating the company-compiled analyst consensus by roughly 24,600 cars — while energy storage deployments and the non-3/Y lineup came in short.

item.title: OpenAI's B2B marketplace opens for business: Decagon joins as a launch partner
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Decagon announced today that it is a launch partner for OpenAI Marketplace, the new B2B storefront that lets enterprise customers apply part of their existing OpenAI commitment toward Decagon's customer-facing AI agents.

item.title: a16z backs Conway's Underdog: a private AI assistant that never leaves your device
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Andreessen Horowitz is leading Conway Research's first funding round for Underdog — a personal AI assistant built to run entirely on your own devices, offline, so the data it needs never leaves them.

item.title: Rapid7 launches Rapid7 Intelligence: an AI-powered threat engine that hunts attacker behavior, not indicators
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Rapid7 launched Rapid7 Intelligence, a unified AI-powered threat-intelligence engine built on 13 years of Rapid7 Labs research — with a modular Linux malware ecosystem targeting telecom edge devices as its first public proof case.

item.title: Ai2 open-sources AstaBrief 8B: cited science reports in 51 seconds, on weights you can run yourself
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: The Allen Institute for AI has open-sourced AstaBrief 8B — an 8-billion-parameter model that turns a research question and retrieved literature excerpts into a cited report. It’s live today as Fast mode in Asta, averaging 51.1 seconds per report against 178.5 seconds for the Claude-powered Thinking mode, under Apache 2.0.

item.title: AKASA launches autonomous AI for inpatient coding — the mid-cycle “holy grail” touching 1 in 10 US hospital discharges
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: AKASA launched an autonomous AI platform for inpatient medical coding and clinical documentation today, moving from AI-assisted prebill review into full autonomy. Its health-system customers already represent about one in ten US inpatient discharges.

item.title: Run Z.ai’s 7,300-star coding agent yourself: a hands-on guide to ZCode
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: ZCode (7,300+ stars, Apache-2.0) is Z.ai’s open-source coding agent harness: terminal TUI, web UI, a plugin marketplace, MCP servers, and deterministic guardrail hooks. Build the agent CLI from source and put hooks around your agent’s tool calls — in about half an hour.

item.title: October is "Holistic AI Governance Month": 31 days of layered controls after a summer of rogue AI agents
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: AIGE Global Advisors declared October 2026 'Holistic AI Governance Month' today — 31 days, one idea a day, across six layers of AI agent control. It follows a summer of rogue agent incidents, and a certification program opens in November.

item.title: GIGABYTE adds a 64GB AI TOP ATOM to its DGX Spark desktop lineup — desktop AI gets a smaller entry point
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: GIGABYTE announced a 64GB version of its AI TOP ATOM desktop AI box today, adding a lower tier to its NVIDIA DGX Spark-based lineup. It ships October 23 — and up to four units can be clustered into a 256GB memory pool.

item.title: Amazon wants to sell $8B of Nvidia chips to investors — then rent them back
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Amazon is reportedly in talks to move roughly $8 billion of Nvidia's Grace Blackwell chips into an investor-backed vehicle and lease them back — the latest sign that Wall Street, not just Big Tech balance sheets, is financing the AI buildout.

item.title: FLUX 3 Image is here: Black Forest Labs ships multi-step editing that leaves the rest of the picture alone
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Black Forest Labs released FLUX 3 Image, the image product of its FLUX 3 family — multi-step, region-precise editing up to 4K, with API access 50% off through October 8 and open weights promised in the coming weeks.

item.title: LG Uplus partners with OptAI to quadruple GPU throughput with token optimization
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: South Korea's LG Uplus said today it is teaming up with AI optimization startup OptAI to develop token optimization technology for server GPUs — targeting 4× the tokens per GPU and lower power draw for large-scale AI services.

item.title: Give your AI agent a browser: hands-on with browser-use, the 117K-star library
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: browser-use (nearly 117K stars, MIT) turns any LLM into an agent that clicks, types, and scrolls like a human. Install the Python library, wire up your model, and drive a real browser from a script — in about 15 minutes.

item.title: Searchable launches Prompt Universe: your AI visibility score may cover 2% of what buyers actually ask
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: AI visibility platform Searchable launched Prompt Universe today, mapping the full range of questions buyers ask AI about a brand — often tens or hundreds of thousands — before narrowing down to the set worth tracking.
